statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (B : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℂ V), LinearIndependent (R p) (fun i => B i)
proof:
intro d B
letI ht : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ V := IsScalarTower.of_compHom (R p) ℂ V
have hs : ∀ r : R p, r • (1 : ℂ) = algebraMap (R p) ℂ r := by
  intro r
  change (algebraMap (R p) ℂ r) • (1 : ℂ) = _
  simp
have hi : Function.Injective (fun r : R p => r • (1 : ℂ)) := by
  simp only [hs]
  intro a b hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (a : ℚ) = (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (b : ℚ) at hab
  exact (algebraMap ℚ ℂ).injective hab
exact LinearIndependent.restrict_scalars (R := R p) (K := ℂ) hi B.linearIndependent
